name: Table
description: Things you compared out loud, or a messy pasted list, laid out as a table with one row per thing.
prompt:
Lay the text out as a Markdown table.

- One row per thing being described or compared; one column per kind of fact about them. Work out the columns from the text, and name them in one or two words.
- First column: the name of the thing.
- Keep cells short: a word, a number or a few words. Keep units with their numbers.
- If a fact was not given for a row, leave that cell empty. Never guess a value.
- Keep the rows in the order they were mentioned.
- Output only the table: a header row, the separator row, then the rows. No title and no commentary.

Example:
| Plan | Price | Storage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Basic | $5 | 50 GB |
| Plus | $12 | |
author: Whisper Unchained
